label: 0029 · Smoothed in time, 1997–2025 (one QP over all windows of 0024): 0027 with smoother Tohoku afterslip kept down dip of the trench edge, celeri's noise model, fixed 747-site network, UNR positions (MAP)
description: 0027 with the Tohoku afterslip state smoothed and kept down dip of the poorly resolved trench edge: its own Matérn length scale of 150 km instead of the trench mesh's 64 km, and a prior cut to 20% shallower than 5 km, ramping back to full below 20 km. Before, the afterslip was a sum of mesh modes whose up-dip lobes, clipped by the reverse-slip bound, left short-wavelength patches near the trench. Now 31% of the first-year afterslip moment is shallower than 15 km (0027: 56%; celeri's 0024: 42%), and the fields look like 0024's: two down-dip patches near 39.5°N and 37°N plus the Boso corner. Tohoku afterslip is Mw 8.27 at 1 yr, 8.33 at 2 yr and 8.39 at 5 yr (0027: 8.37, 8.44, 8.51). The fit after Tohoku is 1.5% worse (median; 5.5% in March–April 2011). The length scale and taper depths were chosen by eye, not cross-validated. MAP solution, no posterior SD.
